verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its structured sections, restrained semantic color, and strong registers feel deliberate, but broad dead bands and ambiguous routing in the publication/retrieval flows keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Failing: the content spans the width, but oversized vertical gaps between the main flow, support panels, and reading guide—plus substantial empty space below—leave the locked frame underused.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Pastel section tints consistently distinguish stages, with red reserved for failure handling and green for publication, though the gray flow lines do not reinforce distinct flow-family semantics.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failing: no crosshair glyphs are visible, but multiple parallel wires and tightly merged bends around the indexes and hybrid retrieval create ambiguous routing and exposed diagram machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Top-stage panels and lower support modules hold clear horizontal registers, but the very sparse panel interiors and large inter-band gaps make the vertical rhythm feel looser than a pin-up-ready composition.
